page.notes: Hebrew letters are copied from the scan but many are blurred by show-through and speckle. Hebrew vowel points are not visible and are not supplied. Entries marked [?] are doubtful: the Hebrew running head on both sides, the Latin "lete" in the first line, "amoveisti" in the right column, and the Hebrew form in the last line. The reference "21. 13." is unclear and may read differently. The page has show-through from the reverse side, which is not transcribed. The Latin in the top-left line reads "f. m. & pl. m." with a corrupted Hebrew form before "lete". The first column's top line may continue from the previous page.
